subject: Private deployment: Seacliff network orchestration & handoff
messages:
From: Ethan Reed <ethan.reed@seaclifftx.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Seacliff IT Network Team <netops@seaclifftx.com>, Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@seaclifftx.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Private — kickoff & network constraints

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with the Redwood Private install for our internal ML workloads. Before the kickoff we'd like to surface a couple of constraints so the initial plan can account for them:

- We have an existing transit VPC with strict egress ACLs.
- Traffic between our dev and prod VPCs must pass through our dataplane appliance (policy enforced).
- We're planning a hybrid topology: VPC peering for prod, private endpoints for dev, and a small on-prem footprint in our colocation for model caching.

I've attached our current VPC inventory and a preliminary network diagram. Can Redwood share a proposed sequencing (network changes, private endpoint provisioning, on-prem appliance schedule) and a short list of information you'll need from our netops team ahead of the kickoff?

Thanks,
Ethan Reed
CTO, Seacliff Therapeutics
Attachment: seacliff-vpc-inventory.xlsx (excel)
Attachment: network-diagram-v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Reed <ethan.reed@seaclifftx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Private — kickoff & network constraints

Thanks Ethan — this is perfect context.

Short answer: yes, we can support the hybrid topology you described. For the kickoff, our standard sequencing looks like:

1) Pre-kickoff intake & inventory validation (this week) — confirm IP ranges, routing, and ACL owners.
2) Private endpoint (dev) prep — generate endpoint CSR and policy templates for your netops to review.
3) VPC peering (prod) dry-run in staging account — validate routing and MTU.
4) On-prem appliance delivery window & install — coordinate with your colo and our field engineer (Marcus).
5) Cutover & smoke tests — prefix caching, KV cache warmup, and latency baselines.

Action items for Seacliff (what we need ASAP):
- Verify the attached inventory rows for each VPC owner and NACLs.
- Provide a contact list for firewall rule approvals.
- Confirm preferred delivery week for on-prem appliance (Marcus is available Jul 16–23).

I'll put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a checklist to share with your netops. Monica will own the MAP and intake form.

Proposed kickoff: Tue Jul 3, 2028 — 10:00am PT. Does that work?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior CS Manager, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Reed <ethan.reed@seaclifftx.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan + intake form (draft)

Ethan, Kimberly — attaching a draft MAP and an intake spreadsheet that mirrors the fields we need from NetOps. Key points in the MAP:

- Intake deadline: Jul 7 — after the intake we'll schedule the staging peering window.
- Network artifacts we need: ACL tables, route table snapshots, transit VPC peering dependencies, and the colo rack owner contact.
- Security/compliance note: If you require HSM-backed keys or a different KMS, flag that now — it can affect the appliance build.

Attachments included: redwood-onprem-shipping-checklist.docx, MAP-v1 (link below).

On the intake spreadsheet: please fill column "Firewall approver email" and mark any non-standard ports. If the netops team has a change freeze window, tell us so we can plan the staging timeline.

Link to MAP: https://docs.redwood.ai/implementations/seacliff/MAP-v1

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-onprem-shipping-checklist.docx (docx)

From: Ethan Reed <ethan.reed@seaclifftx.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@seaclifftx.com>, Seacliff IT Network Team <netops@seaclifftx.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + intake form (draft)

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:

- Delivery week: Jul 22–26 for the on-prem appliance would be better (end of quarter calendar conflicts).
- We use an HSM-managed KMS for all production keys — will Redwood require custom appliance firmware for that?
- Our netops team prefers peering prep on a maintenance window (Saturdays, 02:00–06:00 PT). Can the staging dry-run be scheduled in that window?

I've asked our netops lead (included) to start filling the inventory. We'll upload the first pass by Jul 5.

Thanks,
Ethan

Thanks, Ethan — good notes. Quick replies inline: 

- Appliance delivery: Jul 22–26 works; Marcus will confirm logistics with your colo contact.
- HSM/KMS: we support HSM-backed keys but need the KMS endpoint and certificate chain ahead of build time. Marcus will capture firmware/compatibility requirements.
- Staging dry-run: we can book the Saturday 02:00–06:00 PT window for the staging peering validation.

Next steps (owner):
- Seacliff netops to upload completed intake by Jul 5 (Ethan/Alyssa)
- Redwood to finalize MAP v1 and provide endpoint CSR template by Jul 1 (Monica)
- Logistics sync for on-prem appliance (Marcus) — coordinate dates and colo access list
- Kickoff: tentatively Tue Jul 3, 10:00am PT — Kimberly to send calendar invite pending intake confirmation

If there are any blockers around compliance (SOC 2 scope for the install) let us know and we'll pull in our security manager.

See you on the 3rd — I'll send the invite after noon PT.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior CS Manager, Redwood Inference
